firstDialogue:
The Underground Artist:
Ah yes. Now THIS is real music!

The Underground Artist:
Dance everyone. My music shall not go unheard any longer-

The Underground Artist:
…

The Underground Artist:
Who the-

Detective Rhythm:
(Green streaks in his hair, mask, white coat, green boombox…)

Detective Rhythm:
So you’re this Underground Artist I’ve been hearing about.

Detective Rhythm:
The one who’s been brainwashing all of the citizens in the city.

The Underground Artist:
And you are?

Detective Rhythm:
Detective Rhyth-

The Underground Artist:
I really don’t care to be honest with you.

Detective Rhythm:
H-Huh?

Detective Rhythm:
I think you should considering that I’m the one who’ll be putting you behind ba-

The Underground Artist:
Stop.

The Underground Artist:
Sigh, you authorities all sound the same.

The Underground Artist:
It gets boring hearing the same phrases over and over again y’know?

Detective Rhythm:
W-What are you talking about?

The Underground Artist:
You really think you’re something special don’t you?

The Underground Artist:
You haven’t been the first of the law to find my hideout.

The Underground Artist:
You’ve taken the bait just like the rest of them.

The Underground Artist:
I assume my messages across the city aided you in finding me, no?

Detective Rhythm:
‘They will know my name’, wait…

The Underground Artist:
Quite clever don’t you think?

The Underground Artist:
One that both enlightens the world of my presence

The Underground Artist:
and gives a lead to any law personnel attempting to find me,

The Underground Artist:
only to be brainwashed by my music once they do.

The Underground Artist:
You see where you fall in place now, Mr. Detective Rhythm was it?

The Underground Artist:
You believe yourself to be my downfall,

The Underground Artist:
when in reality you’re just another nobody to be added to my audience.

Detective Rhythm:
N-Not if I have anything to say about it.

Detective Rhythm:
I’ve encountered three other citizens who were under your influence,

Detective Rhythm:
and I managed to snap them out of it.

Detective Rhythm:
I’m putting an end to your crimes now!

The Underground Artist:
Denial won’t get you far Detective, but I admire your resolve.

The Underground Artist:
Very well. If you desire to fall like those who came before so badly,

The Underground Artist:
Then I have no issue with granting that request!
repeatDialogue:
Detective Rhythm:
I'm so close to ending this...

Detective Rhythm:
I can't lose now!
hintDialogue:
The Underground Artist:
Ugh…

Detective Rhythm:
It’s over, Underground Artist.

Citizen 1:
Ughh, my head hurts so much

Citizen 2:
Why am I in a sewer?

Detective Rhythm:
It looks like your brainwashing is wearing off.

Detective Rhythm:
You’re coming with me.

The Underground Artist:
…

The Underground Artist:
Heh.. Well played, Rhythm.

The Underground Artist:
Bested in a battle of tunes, how poetic.

Detective Rhythm:
Don’t try to be friendly now, I haven’t forgotten about your crimes.

The Underground Artist:
Give it a rest, won’t you?

The Underground Artist:
I know when I’ve been beat…

The Underground Artist:
As unfortunate as it is…

Detective Rhythm:
Well then, I'd like to know what your motive behind this charade is.

The Underground Artist:
...

The Underground Artist:
Sigh, let me ask you this, Rhythm...

The Underground Artist:
Have you ever invested so much effort, time and time again

The Underground Artist:
Into something you're passionate about,

The Underground Artist:
Just for it to not get the notoriety it deserves?

The Underground Artist:
My music, so creative, soulful, FLAWLESS even!

The Underground Artist:
Just for no one to listen to it?

The Underground Artist:
After all, what's a musician without an audience?

The Underground Artist:
If I couldn't have one, then I'd make my own.

The Underground Artist:
One that would praise every being of my tunes.

The Underground Artist:
One that would let the world...

The Underground Artist:
Know. My. Name

The Underground Artist:
Sigh, yet YOU had to arrive and ruin it all.

Detective Rhythm:
I understand how you must feel...

Detective Rhythm:
It's very demoralizing to put so much effort into something

Detective Rhythm:
just for it to not get any attention.

Detective Rhythm:
But brainwashing, kidnapping, and forcing citizens to listen to your music

Detective Rhythm:
is unacceptable, and you will have to face the law for it.

The Underground Artist:
Spare me your words, Rhythm.

The Underground Artist:
I'm not trying to persuade you to let me run free.

The Underground Artist:
You asked for a motive, you got your answer.

Detective Rhythm:
Very well.

Detective Rhythm:
In that case, we’ll be heading to the jail promptly.
